recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s-style album cover featuring a central framed photograph of a group in a dimly lit, ornate room, topped by heavy, stylized psychedelic bubble typography and framed by a white border with decorative corner motifs.
coreVisualRelationships: Stacked hierarchy of text elements above the image
Contrast between clean white outer margins and a dark, warm-toned central photo
Repetition of curved, organic shapes in both the typography and the ornate bed headboard
Symmetrical framing of the central subject within a thin-lined border
coreInvariants: Warm, low-key interior lighting with golden highlights
Thin red border with circular corner ornaments
Off-white or cream background for the text area

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central rectangular photograph occupying the bottom two-thirds of the layout.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark-blue and red bubble text at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow: primary title, secondary title, metadata line, then into the central photographic scene.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous white margins at the top and sides provide breathing room for the dense typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue and ochre yellow for the primary and secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm reds and golden yellows within the photograph and text outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the typography contrasts with the muted, earthy tones of the photography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, rounded sans-serif with liquid-like distortions.
letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight kerning with overlapping characters
Bulbous terminals and thick, consistent stroke weights
Curvilinear baselines and cap-heights that mimic fluid movement
Contrast outlines that separate the letterform from the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Swash-like extensions on the 'Y' and 'T' to fill negative space
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, liquid display face and a more structured, decorative slab serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 60s psychedelic bubble aesthetic with interlocking potential.
Matches the decorative, curled slab-serif style of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1960s interior photograph of a group of people in a room with a large ornate gold baroque headboard. Use warm, low-key lighting with golden lamp glow. Frame the photo in a thin red rectangle with circular decorative corners on a cream background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, heavy navy-blue bubble lettering with red outlines at the top. Below it, add ochre-yellow decorative slab-serif text. Ensure all text is centered and follows the vintage pop-art hierarchy.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text interlocking and bulbous?
Does the photograph have a warm, vintage film grain?
Are the corner ornaments present and symmetrical?
Is the color palette restricted to navy, ochre, red, and cream?

adjustableVariables: Degree of 'liquid' distortion in the typography
Complexity of the baroque headboard design
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Legible but highly stylized display type

postGenerationChecks: Check for overlapping letters in the main title
Verify the presence of the thin red border
Ensure the lighting in the photo feels interior and incandescent
Confirm the cream background is consistent across the top margin
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Heavy Psychedelic Display Type] with [Warm Low-Key Interior Photography] framed by [Thin Decorative Borders] on a [Cream Paper Texture].
